subject.title: Preserve provider settings during onboarding updates

question: Should the latest head's provider onboarding contract preserve all existing non-auth provider settings while clearing omitted root and nested credential-bearing fields on rerun?
rationale: The code path writes persisted provider config during onboarding, and the safe auth-clearing boundary is a compatibility-sensitive policy choice even though the patch shape looks correct.

options.title: Land after exact-head validation
options.body: Accept the preserve-non-auth and clear-credentials contract once the current head's checks finish green.

options.title: Tighten the clear/preserve list first
options.body: Update the explicit boundary and add focused regression tests if maintainers want additional provider fields preserved or cleared.

options.title: Pause for broader provider policy
options.body: Hold the PR only if omitted provider auth fields need a different permanent onboarding contract.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Accept the preserve-non-auth and clear-credentials contract once the current head's checks finish green.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, authored the current-head follow-up commits, and has recent history in the shared provider onboarding/config boundary.
